Barfi & Kaju Katli FAQ

What is the difference between barfi and Kaju Katli?

Kaju Katli is a cashew-based Indian sweet. Barfi is a broader family of mithai that can be made with milk, khoya, nuts, or other ingredients.

Are your barfi sweets made fresh?

Yes. Quality Sweets makes mithai fresh daily in Iselin, New Jersey, with no preservatives.

Can I order Kaju Katli online?

Many eligible sweets can ship nationwide. Please check the individual product page for current availability and fulfillment details.

Pickup availability is shown on each product page. Quality Sweets is at 1384 Oak Tree Road in Iselin and is open daily from 10 AM to 8 PM.
